title: Publish the aps product site through GitHub Pages
description: Publish the aps product site through GitHub Pages
no_spec_change_rationale: This change adds static export and delivery automation for the existing documentation site without changing aps CLI or state-store behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The site exports static files under site/out with the /aps-cli base path; pull requests validate the vinext build, static Pages build, rendered output, lint, and production dependency audit; pushes to main upload and deploy the Pages artifact; the existing Sites build remains valid.
